FN-21GUISS-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 83
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Phillip Ensler
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/20/2025
House Bill 83 as introduced would decrease sales and use tax receipts to the Education Trust
Fund by an undetermined amount annually, beginning in Fiscal Year 2026, dependent upon the
purchases made by the Alabama State Missionary Baptist Convention, Inc. and its members that
are in good standing, which would be exempt from state sales and use tax pursuant to this bill.
This bill could also decrease sales and use tax receipts to local governments by an undetermined
amount, beginning in Fiscal Year 2026, dependent upon the same purchases made by the
Convention or its members, if the respective local governments adopt an exemption from local
sales and use tax, pursuant to this bill.
In addition, this bill requires the Convention to provide an annual report of its members in good
standing to the Department of Revenue.
